articles.title: Common constipation drug may help clear depression brain fog
articles.description: An existing constipation drug may have an unexpected new use: helping clear the "brain fog" that often lingers after depression. The drug targets a serotonin receptor found in both the gut and the brain, and researchers saw no significant side effects.
